tech.onesa_desc1: Onesa AI ndiyo modheru yedu yakagadzirirwa kujekesa nzira yekuti ungararama, ungadyara mari, uye ungabudirira sei muZimbabwe. Kunyangwe mamwe maAI epasi rose akashaya ruzivo rwemuno, Onesa yakavakwa kubva pasi kuti inzwisise mamiriro eZimbabwe kupfuura chero ipi zvayo modheru.
tech.onesa_desc2: Kubva pakufambidzana nemitemo yemuno kusvika pakugadzira mazano ebhizimisi anogadzirisa matambudziko eZimbabwe, Onesa inopa zivo yemuno yaunoda kuti ubudirire.
